title: Unemployment Benefit Claims Schedule of Extended Benefits Fractions by Parent Claim Attachment
content:
For an Extended Benefits (EB) entitlement on Unemployment Benefit Claims, the Extended Benefits fraction — the fraction of the parent entitlement measure that enters the Extended Benefits maximum benefit amount — follows the parent claim's payment record and wages.

The weekly payments counted are the weekly payments issued on the parent claim (payment entries of the weekly kind).

| Weekly payments issued on the parent claim | Parent base-period wages | Extended Benefits fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 20 or more | At least 60 times the parent's weekly benefit amount (the high-wage test) | 0.52 (the long-attachment fraction) |
| 20 or more | Below 60 times the parent's weekly benefit amount | 0.51 (the attachment fraction) |
| Fewer than 20 | Any | 0.5 (the standard fraction of one half) |

## Boundary cases (hypothetical parent with a weekly benefit amount of 346.00, so a high-wage test of 20760.00)

| Weekly payments on the parent | Parent base-period wages | Fraction |
|---|---|---|
| 20 | 20760.00 | 0.52 |
| 20 | 20759.99 | 0.51 |
| 19 | 30000.00 | 0.5 |
